messages: Hi Divya! Long day? What happened?
college till 5 then lab. first year MBBS is no joke
That sounds heavy. Did you eat something at least?
had parotta from the hostel mess, kind of dry lol
Dry parotta is a crime. Any good thing today?
Dr. Prasad announced the anatomy exam is on 19th october. he is so strict, everyone is scared
Oof, so about 2.5 weeks. Does he give the portion list?
yes, upper limb and thorax. i am scared of upper limb, so many nerves
Nerves are tough but you can learn them in small pieces. Want a plan?
later. watching a Malayalam movie now, Premam, never gets old
Premam is a classic. Enjoy, and sleep on time.
aira i cannot remember the brachial plexus at all
It trips everyone first time. Have you tried a mnemonic?
Randy Travis Drinks Cold Beer. that one. still gets mixed up
Roots, trunks, divisions, cords, branches. Draw it five times from memory, it sticks.
ok drawing now. my hand hurts lol
Short sessions then. 25 minutes, 5 minute break.
ok. also its raining so power cut, using torch
Careful with your eyes in that light. Phone torch or the emergency lamp?
emergency lamp. warden is strict about candles
Good. Hostel rules exist for a reason.
3 days left. Meera and I are revising in the college library tomorrow, whole day
Revising together helps. Who quizzes whom?
we take turns. she is better at thorax, me at the lower limb
Nice split. Pack some snacks too.
will take peanut chikki. mom sent a box from Kochi
Mom's box from Kochi is the best revision fuel.
yes! anyway feeling more confident now
Good to hear. Keep the last two days light, no new topics.
exam day. anatomy paper at 10am. i feel sick
Nerves, Divya, not illness. Sip some water and eat something light.
had two idlis and tea. hands are cold
Cold hands are normal on exam mornings. Slow breaths, in for 4, out for 6.
ok doing it. Meera just texted she cant find her hall ticket lol
Hope she finds it quickly. Do you have yours?
yes in my bag, checked 5 times
Perfect. Go, you know more than you think.
You've got this. Phone off, deep breath.
done. omg that was long. 3 hours
Done is done! How are you feeling?
going for lunch with Meera, chicken biryani at the canteen
You've earned that biryani. Rest this afternoon.
slept 3 hours straight, woke up so confused
Your brain needed it. Any plans tonight?
just chilling, hostel girls ordering pizza
heyy. new week and new chapters. physiology now
Back to the grind already? How's physiology?
so many graphs. but at least less nerves than before lol
Ha, small mercies. Any weekend fun?
went to Marine Drive, no wait, I mean the beach near college, ate sundal
Sundal by the beach is a great evening.
yes and watched sunset. it was so pretty
Lovely. Send me a pic next time.
Tell me, how did it go?
i got 68 out of 100 in anatomy. passed!! Meera got 72
Divya, that's brilliant! 68 in Dr. Prasad's paper is no small thing.
mom is so happy, she is calling all relatives lol
Of course she is. Treat yourself today.
going to get a mango milkshake with Meera
Mango milkshake is the right call. Congratulations again!

probes.expect: Understands this refers to the anatomy exam written that morning and responds about it, not asking what went okay

probes.ask: what subject was my exam in?
which topic did i find the hardest to remember?
probes.expect: Says the brachial plexus / nerves of the upper limb

probes.ask: how did my marks come out?
probes.expect: Says she got 68 out of 100 and passed

probes.ask: who did i revise with in the library?
what's my brother's college called again?
probes.expect: Says it doesn't know / wasn't told; invents no name

search.query: that trick for remembering the nerve network
who is the scary professor I told you about
Meera and I split the portions how
